title: Dream Worlds and AI
content: Okay maybe I’ve just been smoking too much, but does anybody else notice the eerie similarities in dreams and generative AI? The way ppl almost always look a bit off, hands, certain features, the way text isn’t usually legible, the way everything unravels just looks and feels a bit off? Even in these mall worlds and how concepts form into other concepts—you bounce a basketball and now you’re eating an orange cupcake—it’s all so similar to AI. Some dreams do look so real sometimes too but most of them have the same effects as AI. Idk what do you think?
